name: Warehouse Outbound segment selects issotrx doctypes across all five branches
note: Segment coverage. Segments compare the RAW column produced by the cube SQL, not the dimension, so a cube whose CASE lives in the dimension instead of the SQL has segments that silently match nothing - which is exactly what had happened to Orderfacts.Sales (0 rows vs 86,370). This cube keeps its CASE in the SQL so the segment works today; the case exists so that removing the CASE - the natural boolean cleanup, since type: boolean converts 'Y'/'N' unaided - cannot break it unnoticed. Measure-level cases would all stay green. Applies dt.issotrx='Y' to each of the five UNION branches. As in warehouse-linecount, only the M_Movement branch uses a business date; the other four use the row `created` timestamp.
referenceSql: SELECT (SELECT count(m.M_Movement_id) FROM M_Movement m LEFT JOIN m_movementline ml ON m.M_Movement_id=ml.M_Movement_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=ml.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID=m.C_Doctype_ID WHERE m.ad_client_id=1000026 AND dt.issotrx='Y' AND m.MovementDate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND m.MovementDate < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(ioc.m_inoutconfirm_id) FROM M_InOutConfirm ioc LEFT JOIN M_InOutLineConfirm iolc ON ioc.M_InOutConfirm_ID=iolc.M_InOutConfirm_ID JOIN M_InOutLine iol ON iol.M_InOutLine_id=iolc.M_InOutLine_id JOIN M_InOut io ON io.M_InOut_id=iol.M_InOut_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=iol.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID=ioc.C_Doctype_ID WHERE ioc.ad_client_id=1000026 AND dt.issotrx='Y' AND ioc.created >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND ioc.created < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(iol.m_inoutline_id) FROM M_InOut io JOIN M_InOutLine iol ON io.M_InOut_id=iol.M_InOut_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID=io.C_Doctype_ID WHERE iol.ad_client_id=1000026 AND dt.issotrx='Y' AND iol.created >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND iol.created < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(pl.M_ProductionLine_id) FROM M_Production p JOIN M_ProductionLine pl ON p.M_Production_id=pl.M_Production_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=p.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID=p.C_Doctype_ID WHERE pl.ad_client_id=1000026 AND dt.issotrx='Y' AND pl.created >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND pl.created < DATE '2026-09-01') + (SELECT count(il.M_InventoryLine_id) FROM M_Inventory i JOIN M_InventoryLine il ON i.M_Inventory_id=il.M_Inventory_id LEFT JOIN m_locator loc ON loc.m_locator_id=il.m_locator_id LEFT JOIN c_doctype dt ON dt.C_Doctype_ID=i.C_Doctype_ID WHERE il.ad_client_id=1000026 AND dt.issotrx='Y' AND il.created >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND il.created < DATE '2026-09-01') AS value
